info.name: MarketMaster ERP API v2 — Phase 3 Updated

item.name: 1. Authentication & Identity
item.description: Auth lifecycle — login, registration, password management, and invitation-based vendor/admin flows.

request.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT + refreshToken.

item.name: 2. Admin Onboarding (Trust Handshake)
item.description: Secure multi-step physical & digital handshake onboarding for Market Masters, District Admins, and Pseudo Market Admin staff.

request.description: SuperAdmin only. Creates a signed invitation token and sends it to the prospective admin via email.
Market Authority only. Verifies NIN physically and issues a 6-digit handshake code for the candidate admin.
Public endpoint. Validates the handshake code and activates the admin account.
Market Authority only. Immediately locks a market admin account for security review.

item.name: 3. Market Registry (Infrastructure)
item.description: Market hierarchy management — create markets, sections, gates, and retrieve stakeholder registries.

item.name: 4. Vendor & Product Management
item.description: Vendor registry, approval workflow, product CRUD, and bulk CSV import.

formdata.description: CSV headers: name, category, unit, price, cost_price, current_stock, min_stock, facility_id, sku, barcode

query.description: Set to true to validate without saving

item.name: 5. Market Staff (Pseudo Admins)
item.description: Gate Counters, Stock Counters, and Revenue Collectors employed by Market Authority.

request.description: Requires prior Employment Document submission from Market Authority.

item.name: 6. Gate & Token Operations
item.description: Vehicle entry/exit, stock dispatch/receipt, parking, and tax tokens. Aliases: /api/gate/* and /api/market/tokens/*

request.description: Returns a branded PDF receipt for the gate token.

item.name: 7. Revenue Hub (Finance — Mixed Approach)
item.description: All payment & revenue APIs. Note: Frontend uses finance-engine.ts for real-time estimates; backend is authoritative on submit.

item.name: 8. Inventory Management
item.description: Market-wide stock movement tracking with full IN/OUT audit trail.

item.name: 9. KYC & Document Pipeline
item.description: Document upload, KYC submission queue, review, and PDF generation for contracts, invoices, and market reports.

item.name: 10. Supply Chain & Requisitions
item.description: Vendor-initiated procurement requisitions, supplier bidding, delivery tracking, and supplier ratings.

item.name: 11. Support & Resolution Centre
item.description: User-initiated support ticket lifecycle management with AI summarisation.

request.description: Triggers AI summarisation of ticket thread for admin review.

item.name: 12. Compliance & Audit Console
item.description: NIN verification, global audit log access, and compliance reporting.

request.description: SuperAdmin/MarketMaster only. Returns non-repudiable action logs with oldData/newData diffs.

item.name: 14. Bulk Operations
item.description: CSV batch imports for large-scale data setup.

exec: // Auto-set timestamp header for audit logs
